== Description ==

A player at a table during the [[2022 World Championship]] in Atlanta, holding a card, with SWCCG cards, a deck box and a Let's Play box on the table. He wears a green Oakland Athletics cap, a black T-shirt and a full beard. He is not yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-2022, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327), 18 October 2022 (18:17 Eastern), one of the photographs in a multi-file post. Original file name: IMG_4204.jpg (3024×4032); Slack file id F046NQ2JXFH.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Chris Schoenthal]] (Slack: imrahil327)
* '''Date:''' not recorded (posted 18 October 2022, after the 14–16 October event).
* '''Identification:''' The player is not yet identified.

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
